title: Planner Agent in Copilot Chat: task assignment, scheduled catch-up and memory
summary: The rollout, licensing requirement and default-on behaviour match Microsoft's notice. Hold for the memory configuration call: it lists property names without the required Boolean value and JSON request body, so it cannot be used as printed. The statement that catch-up suggestions from private messages can be saved into shared plans also goes beyond the evidence.

claims.claim: No tenant admin UI for Enhanced personalization is documented in the references found.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Enhanced personalization admin center UI control memory. Read memory management, Enhanced personalization control overview, and Configure Microsoft Copilot settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center; found Graph configuration, not a tenant UI path.

claims.claim: The printed PATCH call with '(isEnabledInOrganization, disabledForGroup)' is a usable configuration call for Enhanced personalization.
claims.quote: | isEnabledInOrganization | Boolean | If true, enables the enhanced personalization control and therefore related features as defined in control enhanced personalization privacy Required. |
claims.fix: Replace the call with 'PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization' and supply 'Content-Type: application/json' with the JSON body '{"isEnabledInOrganization": false}' to turn the control off tenant-wide. Remove the parenthesised property list. The cited reference requires a Boolean value in the request body, not bare property names.
